thread:
Marta: Heads-up — starting onboarding for mariner-14b (fp16 / int8 candidate). Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/mariner-14b/v0.1/weights.tar.lz4. Can infra confirm checksum+placement?
Josh: Confirmed presence, checksums match. Path live and tagged as catalog:mariner-14b:v0.1.
Liam: Quick note — tokenizer behavior differs: trailing_space normalization is on and we're seeing +1 token on a bunch of short prompts vs our standard bpe.
Marta: Thanks. Which tokenizer files exactly? I'll add a note to catalog metadata.
Josh: Tokenizer files are at s3://redwood-models/mariner-14b/tokenizer/ — vocab.json + merges.txt. Current tokenizer config has add_eos = true. That was intentional by model team?
Liam: add_eos=true causes mismatch with prompt prefixing in our rewriter — we should set add_eos=false and handle EOS in the serving wrapper. I'll open a PR.
Marta: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/787 — small change to tokenizer config. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Running perf sweep on pool a2-gpu-32 (A100-SXM). Baseline single-stream median latency ~230ms @ max_tokens=128, batch_size=1. Throughput starts to get noisy beyond batch 8.
deploy-bot: perf-run started by @Kevin on pool a2-gpu-32. Run id: perf-2330001122-01
Kevin: Noticed high tail latency at p95 when batch_size > 6. Suspect KV cache merging/evictions. Sample log: ```[2026-02-12T12:10:05Z] batch=8 qlen=8 kv_cache_misses=62 latency=420ms```
Marta: Can you also run with continuous_batching=false for comparison? We suspect batching merge overhead.
Liam: Also try serving with kv_prefetch=true — sometimes helps for long-context setups.
Kevin: Will run both. Planning 3 experiments: continuous_batching on/off, kv_prefetch on/off, and batch sweep {1,2,4,6,8,12}. ETA ~40m.
Priya: FYI — added tokenizer note to catalog metadata: "requires wrapper: no eos add".
Marta: Also need to validate model.yaml: include float_precision: fp16 and quant_mode: int8_dynamic (if we keep quantized path). Double-check ci fixtures.
Josh: Code review ping @Marta @Liam on the onboarding PR — small config tweak and a failing fixture path in CI.
Marta: On it, re-running CI now and will push a fix if needed.
Liam: If tail latency persists, consider lowering batcher_max_batch_time_ms from 5 -> 2 to reduce queueing spin.
Kevin: Quick results: continuous_batching=true, kv_prefetch=false -> batch=1 median=228ms p95=260ms; batch=8 median=360ms p95=780ms. continuous_batching=false, kv_prefetch=false -> batch=8 median=410ms p95=430ms. So merging increases p95 a lot due to head-of-line queueing.
Marta: Good data. Proposal: set catalog default continuous_batching=false, recommend batch_size=4, max_wait_ms=2. That should hit a better latency/throughput sweet spot.
Priya: I'll update the catalog entry and add the change to the release notes.
Marta: Any objections to marking mariner-14b as catalog:experimental until we finish perf on V100 and g1 pools?
Josh: Fine by me. @Kevin can you also run a sanity on g1-16 to validate memory/quant-kernel fallback?
Kevin: Scheduling a quick check on g1-16 now.
Liam: One more tokenizer quirk: merges.txt had CRLFs which caused tokenization diffs during training — fixed in PR.
Marta: Great. Next steps summary: finalize model.yaml, merge PR after CI, update catalog metadata, set default serving config continuous_batching=false, batch_size=4, max_wait_ms=2. I'll post a short summary in #eng-ml-stats once the catalog update is live.
Josh: :eyes: thanks all."
